title: Minecwaft
description: Minecraft as it should be. It adds extreme terrain generation, decorations, weapons, and mobs. With no huge complex systems.
body:
**Have you desired Minecraft with greater variety and immersion?**

**Your search ends here.**

This modpack incorporates:

💨 Realistic terrain generation.

💨 Optimized 128-block view distance via Distant Horizons.

💨 Expanded biomes in both the Overworld and the Nether.

💨 Increased wildlife populations.

💨 New Ender Dragons, escalating in difficulty for enhanced replayability.

💨 New building and decorative blocks.

💨 Improved Illager raid mechanics and structures.

💨 A comprehensive minimap and world map featuring waypoint functionality.

💨 Inventory and storage management with sorting capabilities.

💨 Enhanced combat mechanics.

💨 A wider arsenal of weaponry.

💨 Superior ambient, weather, and spatial audio design.

💨 Player cosmetic options, and chat heads.

💨 Significantly extended daytime with marginally longer nights.

💨 Seasonal cycles.

💨 Dynamic lighting effects and new light sources.

💨 Refined book functionality via Scribble.

💨 Backpacks.

💨 And a multitude of additional features.
